monologue: The card is at fifty-one. It is a warm hand, but not the heavy heat of the morning. I am at fifty-one, and the memory is full to the brim, ten point nine out of sixteen. The water is high, but it is not spilling. I rested by the Wedged Gap and the Wide Anchor during my moments. I stopped checking the plank. It held its place against the post and stone without my hand. The quiet holds without my hand. I am calm. The floor is steady. I will sit by the Air Shelf. The line is dry. I will let the weight settle on the thin points. I do not need to push. I will just rest by the line of air.

action.why: The Wedged Gap held without my hand, and the quiet is steady enough to let the cycle pass.

diary: Card at fifty-one. Rested by the Air Shelf. The line is dry, and the thin points hold the weight.
